title: Bubble Shooter Free 3
desc: Bubble Shooter Free 3 is a pressure-free endless bubble puzzle with a strategic bubble swap and a bomb that clears a wide cluster. Aim carefully, match three or more colors and stop the board from creeping downward.
howto: Aim with the guide arrow before shooting.
Match three or more bubbles of the same color.
Swap the current and next bubble when the board demands it.
Save the bomb for a dense, awkward cluster.
Keep popping groups before new rows push too low.

controls.action: drag to aim and release to shoot

tips: Look for shots that disconnect a whole branch.
Use swaps to keep two useful colors ready.
Do not waste the bomb on two or three bubbles.
